ACCESS: plain direct fetch throughout via probe.fetch (curl_cffi; profiles edge101 / chrome124 / chrome131 / safari17_0 / safari17_2_ios / safari18_0 / safari18_0_ios all answered 200). No WAF challenge, no 403, no 429, no proxy needed. ROBOTS: https://zgallerie.com/robots.txt fetched first, HTTP 200. It names NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User agent - the only named agents are adsbot-google, Nutch (full disallow), AhrefsBot, AhrefsSiteAudit, MJ12bot, Pinterest and Googlebot. The 'User-agent: *' blocks disallow /admin, /cart, /checkout/*, /orders/*, /search, /products/search, /user, /preview, /trade/*, /invoices, /payment_methods, /transit_page, two /api/ paths and - in the trailing block - '/*?filter' and '/en/'. I touched none of those: no search URL and no ?filter URL was requested, which also matches rule 25/27. Sitemap declared: https://zgallerie.com/sitemap.xml.

PLATFORM + TREE: the site runs on Shopline; category URLs are /c-<id>-<slug>. The React mega-menu is not in the served homepage HTML, so - as in the prior Furniture and Home-Decor passes on this SR - the nav object was taken from the site's own JS bundle: https://zgallerie.com/cdn/shop/s/prod/tkf57vc73di9hfq5/public/static/zg_bundle.common.js (HTTP 200, 204,647 bytes), where the object literal internalName:"2025-2026 Z Gallerie Meganav" begins at byte 88,710. I parsed EVERY internalName in that meganav object: 478 nodes in total, covering the departments NEW, ROOM INSPIRATION, FURNITURE, DECOR, ART & MIRRORS, PILLOWS & THROWS, BEDDING & CURTAINS, LIGHTING, RUGS, GIFTS, HOLIDAY, LABOR DAY SALE, BEST SELLERS, SHOP BY ROOM, INSPIRATION, THE GALLERIE GUIDE, REGISTRY, FREE DESIGN SERVICES and TRADE & B2B. There is NO Bath, Bathroom, Bath & Body, Shower, Vanity, Sanitaryware, Faucet, Tap, Toilet, Basin, Sink or Bathroom-Storage node anywhere in those 478 nodes - a case-insensitive grep for "bath" across the whole bundle returns ZERO hits inside the meganav object.

SECOND, INDEPENDENT TREE SOURCE: https://zgallerie.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml (HTTP 200, 149,007 bytes) - the complete published collection set, 560 URLs. Grepped all 560 for bath|shower|toilet|vanit|sink|basin|faucet|tap|soap|towel|mirror|medicine|hamper|lavat|spa|bidet|tub. The ONLY matches are 12 mirror collections (art-mirrors, mirrors, wall-mirrors, floor-mirrors, round-mirrors, mirror-furniture, new-mirrors, best-selling-art-mirrors x2, art-mirrors-sale, art-mirrors-clearance, mirror-glowing-bedroom, new-art-mirrors) plus /c-2105-best-selling-bed-and-bath. Not one bathroom fixture, furniture, storage or accessory collection exists. The two sources agree exactly.

THIRD CHECK - PRODUCT LEVEL: https://zgallerie.com/sitemap_products_1.xml (HTTP 200, 968,259 bytes) lists 2,178 product URLs, i.e. the entire catalogue. Grepping all 2,178 slugs for bath|shower|toilet|vanit|sink|basin|faucet|soap|towel|toothbrush|hamper|tub|robe|lotion|apothecary returns SIX hits, and none is a bathroom product: 'moon-shower' (a wall-art print), 'jungle-toile-robe-set' (the bathrobe routed to Textile above), three Roberto BED skus (the substring 'bed' pattern artefact), and 'capri-vanity-ivory-soft-gold-velvet-mirror-tray' - a decorative dressing-table tray, not bathroom sanitaryware. So Z Gallerie sells no toilets, basins, baths, showers, enclosures, taps/faucets, bath hardware, bath storage, soap dispensers, toothbrush holders or vanity units at all.

QTY METHOD (for the two review entries only): Z Gallerie renders its own total in div.facets-count as 'N items'. Robes = '1 items' and 1 data-product-id tile (agree). Mirrors = '45 items' and 45 data-product-id tiles (agree). Counts discriminate per node (1 vs 45 vs 3), so they are not a site-wide constant.

All mirror collections -> Decor by hierarchy (rule 29), logged in review. Bedding, curtains, pillows, throws -> Textile department, no bathroom framing (rules 30-33). Jewelry Storage, Coin Banks, Perfume Bottles, Decorative Bowls & Trays, Vases & Canisters -> Decorative Home Accessories (rule 21), none presented as bathroom. Lighting department contains no bathroom/vanity light node (checked: Chandeliers, Pendants, Electric Wall Sconces, Table Lamps, Floor Lamps + by-material cuts only), so nothing was routed to Lighting. CONCLUSION: confirmed absence, not an access failure - status NO BATHROOM FOUND with rows = [] per rule 36.
